name: Sagar Khedu Sarvangi Vikas Yojana
benefit:

**Infrastructure Improvement:** Work is planned for the improvement of distribution lines, construction of new 66 Kilovolt sub stations, and repair and modernization of transmission lines.

_eligibility_text: ***The guidelines of the scheme do not define any specific eligibility criteria. However, the target groups benefiting from the infrastructure and connection provisions will be the following:*** - Electricity consumers living in the coastal area. - Industrial, residential, or agricultural customers located in the coastal areas. - Consumers residing within one of the 39 taluks of the 15 districts of the Sagar Kantha area. - Farmer seeking a new agricultural electricity connection in the areas of Paschim Gujarat Vij Company Limited (PGVCL) company.
